overall_reason: A plain, token-driven app screen with no decorative slop, but its structure is a default: three equal pricing cards bolted above a two-item project list, and every one of five buttons is the same primary blue, so nothing on the screen was ranked by a person.

findings.where: whole screen, 1440 and 375: buttons 'Choose Starter', 'Choose Team', 'Choose Scale', 'Create draft project', 'Export'
findings.evidence: All five buttons are .btn-primary on #1d4ed8 at the same 50px height; at 375 the three plan buttons are larger than 'Create draft project'. Failed T-FIVE-SECOND on 'what to do': the screen offers five equal next actions on a page titled 'Projects'.
findings.after: One primary action for the page's job ('Create draft project'); 'Export' as a secondary/outline button; plan buttons as secondary or moved off this screen
findings.why: Equal emphasis everywhere is the default an agent produces when nobody decided what the screen is for.

findings.where: top of page, div.plans above h2 'Your projects'
findings.evidence: A page titled 'Projects' leads with a three-tier pricing row ('$9 / month', '$29 / month', '$99 / month') before the user's own projects. Failed T-MIRROR: the stock three-tier pricing block would be dropped into any SaaS screen the same way.
findings.after: Lead with the project list and its create action; move plan choice to billing or a single upgrade line tied to a real limit [DATA NEEDED: which plan limit the user is hitting]
findings.why: Each screen gets one job; a pricing upsell above the work list is the stock 'three pricing tiers' section used as filler.

findings.evidence: Three identical cards (same radius 20px, #f4f4f6 fill, 1px border, name/price/button) with no feature, limit or difference stated; deleting the cards' shells loses nothing (T-DELETION). The plans cannot be compared: nothing says what $29 buys over $9.
findings.before: Starter / $9 / month / Choose Starter (x3 with names swapped)
findings.after: State the one difference that sets each plan apart [DATA NEEDED: seat or project limits per plan], or render as a compact comparison row
findings.why: Equal cards with only the label swapped are a card kit, not a decision aid.

findings.evidence: Action colour #1d4ed8 is Tailwind blue-700 used as the only accent; the sweep's stock_swatches did not flag it.
findings.after: A product-owned accent [DATA NEEDED: brand colour], kept at >= 4.5:1 with white text
findings.why: A framework swatch as the brand accent is a default nobody chose.

strengths: Real design tokens with a dark-mode set and a visible 3px focus ring with offset: keep them.
Copy is plain and literal ('Create draft project', 'Export'); no slop diction, eyebrows, icons or decoration.
not_investigated: Async behaviour of 'Create draft project', 'Export' and plan buttons (the empty #toast and .btn.is-busy suggest optimistic or fake success states) could not be observed from static evidence; needs a live click test with the network blocked (T-FAKE-SEND / INT-004).
T-FRESH-READER: only two content lines exist ('Website redesign', 'Mobile app'), both placeholder-like project names; not raised as a finding.
